description: Single-shop commercial KTV box simulation. Phone QR ordering, YouTube real-time streaming (no ads), dual-mode original/instrumental playback, Demucs vocal removal, lyrics sync, multi-room, virtual billing timer, atmosphere animations. Local LAN only. Personal learning / Demo. Copyright OUT of scope.

in: Next.js 14 App Router phone UI (zh-TW only)
Next.js 14 App Router big-screen TV UI
FastAPI backend with WebSocket per-room channels
SQLite storage (rooms, queue, songs, sessions, jobs)
yt-dlp integration: search, stream URL extraction, subtitle fetch, MP4 cache
Demucs htdemucs GPU vocal removal pipeline (cached)
Dual-mode playback: original | muted-video + instrumental audio
Queue management: add, reorder, insert next, remove, fair rotation by user
Comprehensive README with cookies.txt workflow + manual QA checklist

stories.title: WebSocket per-room broadcast

Connection manager broadcasts queue events only to subscribers of same room_id
Events: queue.added, queue.removed, queue.reordered, playback.state, vocal_removal.ready, room.timer.tick

stories.title: yt-dlp integration: search, stream URL, subtitles
acceptanceCriteria: api/services/youtube.py search(query, n) returns list of {id,title,duration,channel,thumbnail,view_count}
api/services/youtube.py get_stream(video_id) returns {video_url, audio_url, expires_at, vtt_path|None}

stories.title: Demucs vocal removal pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: api/services/demucs_worker.py exposes enqueue_vocal_removal(video_id) -> job_id
Worker runs htdemucs on GPU (CUDA detected) or falls back to CPU with warning
Output instrumental track saved to data/instrumentals/{video_id}.mp3
Job status tracked in jobs table: pending, running, done, failed
On completion, broadcasts vocal_removal.ready event over WS to room_id that requested
pytest api/tests/test_demucs_worker.py passes with mocked subprocess
README documents the GPU detection, expected time, and CPU fallback caveat

Cached to data/lyrics/{hash}.json
pytest api/tests/test_lyrics.py passes with mocked HTTP

stories.title: Phone UI: enter room, search, request song

Visible queue list with current playing + position, your songs highlighted
Long-press / button to remove your own song
Toggle: 原曲 / 去人聲 (sets vocal_mode on queue item)
Responsive layout works on 375x667 viewport (vitest snapshot or playwright responsive check)

stories.title: Big screen UI: player, lyrics, animations
acceptanceCriteria: Route /tv/[roomId] renders fullscreen black layout with QR code overlay (closeable)
One-time 'Click to start room' unlock button to satisfy autoplay-with-sound policy
HTML5 <video> element streams from yt-dlp stream URL, muted with parallel <audio> if vocal_mode='instrumental'

Atmosphere animations triggered: clap (manual button on phone), confetti (song end), fireworks (high score idle), birthday (manual)
Per-room timer in corner showing elapsed time + virtual cost (NT$X/min)
Auto-advance to next song on ended event
WS-driven queue updates without reload
